title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-26
source: SDB>>MR>>PCM>>DAT>>CDR there may be a cassette gen somewhere in the  lineage, but i am not positive.

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard capture of a historic Phil Lesh 6‑string debut with the tight, high‑energy ’82 Dead sound.
ai_review.review: The recording is a decent soundboard (sbd) source that delivers the characteristic tight 1982 Dead vibe. Reviewers highlight the historical significance of Phil Lesh’s first night playing an Alembic 6‑string bass, adding extra interest to the show. Overall the performance feels energetic and well‑tight, though no specific song moments are called out.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show 4 stars and notes a decent soundboard recording with high energy, leading to an overall rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a decent sbd recording; clear enough to capture the tight 1982 sound with no major issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; focus is on overall tightness and historical note.

band_member_comments.Phil: First show using a 6‑string Alembic bass noted as historically significant.
